rationale: MU is the book's most crowded long: funding maxed at 0.00148, l/s 2.13, RSI 72, structure_bias -0.56 - a long here means chasing extreme crowding +1.66% above VWAP right as the last three 15m bars stall and repeatedly reject 888-889 (888.34/888.62/889.40 highs, closing off highs). That is precisely the late-entry-into-stretched-tape pattern this account bleeds on, and the maxed funding is fuel for a squeeze lower, so I will not buy up here. But ADX 83.5 flags a genuinely powerful uptrend and support is 80 pts away, so a naked short into that with fresh two-sided China/export-control headline risk inside 48h has no clean 1.5R structural level and negative expectancy. Stand aside: the highest-expectancy move is to wait for the crowd to resolve rather than pick a side mid-air.

reconsider.note: Reclaiming and holding above the 888-890 rejection ceiling proves the squeeze-up is continuing and flips this to a breakout-momentum long; failure to reclaim keeps the crowded-long/squeeze-lower thesis intact.
